column1: # Regex spec scope (owner decision 46): which Java sources the regex census reads; the first matching glob wins.
# glob: "*" matches within one path segment, "**" as a whole segment matches any number of segments.
# gated: the canon gate check regex_spec refuses a new site without a row. baseline-*: rows recorded, not gated.
# A path that no glob matches is upstream OpenJDK source and outside the spec.

column3: vendored donor sources (Guava, Lucene, OpenNLP) kept as published upstream
